items.title: 不只便宜！中國鏡頭、跑鞋靠實力圈粉 歐美玩家開始搶著買
items.title_en: Not Just Cheap! Chinese Camera Lenses and Running Shoes Win Fans with Quality, Players in the West Start Buying
paras: 從相機鏡頭、鋼筆到跑鞋，部分中國品牌正改變歐美消費者對「中國製造」的印象。它們不再只是預算有限時的替代選擇，而是憑藉品質、設計與價格優勢，獲得講究器材的玩家認可，甚至讓海外買家願意費心跨境購買。
這股轉變的關鍵，在於產品本身開始經得起挑剔使用者的檢驗，再加上快速回應建議、補足大品牌忽略的需求，讓原本缺乏知名度的業者，透過專業評測與社群口碑打開市場。

副廠鏡頭不再只拚便宜 品質與回應速度贏得信任

相機鏡頭是製造難度極高的消費產品，光學元件必須精準排列，自動對焦馬達與光圈葉片也不能出錯。願意花上千美元購買鏡頭的攝影玩家，對畫質與品管尤其挑剔。
中國鏡頭品牌唯卓仕(Viltrox)早期主打平價副廠選擇，吸引不願花更多錢購買日系原廠鏡頭的消費者。但約四年前，公司投入材料與製造改善後，陸續推出75mm人像鏡頭、13mm廣角鏡頭等獲好評產品，評價逐漸從「以這個價格來說不錯」，變成產品本身就值得肯定。
經營攝影YouTube頻道pal2tech的Chris Lee表示，過去玩家對副廠鏡頭的疑慮已明顯淡化。他2019年測試唯卓仕產品時，曾批評鏡頭偏大、笨重，卻也發現公司對使用者意見反應很快。
Chris Lee說：「我在頻道上提到一個問題，兩周後就有韌體更新把它修好了。」
唯卓仕美國行銷主管Frank Fang指出，消費者可能喜歡現有產品，卻希望它更小、更便宜，或更符合實際使用習慣，這些未被滿足的需求就是品牌的機會。
隨著品質改善，唯卓仕也推出更輕巧、大光圈或採用不同焦段的鏡頭，填補大品牌產品線的空缺。對可能長期持有鏡頭的攝影玩家而言，這些差異足以影響購買決定。Chris Lee形容：「攝影師和相機談戀愛，卻會和鏡頭結婚。」
類似變化也出現在鋼筆與折疊刀市場。Asvine、Hongdian等中國鋼筆品牌，以外觀及書寫表現獲收藏者肯定；從代工起家的WE Knife與Reate，也透過自有設計與精細做工，逐步獲得玩家認可。

跑鞋靠實測口碑突圍 小品牌也能吸引海外買家

跑鞋是另一個受到關注的領域。安踏(02020-HK)今年2月在比佛利山莊開店，李寧(02331-HK)則於6月與NBA球星Stephen Curry簽下長期代言協議，擴大美國布局。兩家公司也透過跑步網紅介紹產品，並在亞馬遜(AMZN-US)銷售，讓美國消費者更容易購買。
物理治療師、跑鞋評測平台Doctors of Running創辦人Matt Klein表示，部分中國跑鞋售價明顯較低，品質卻同樣出色，甚至更好。他也發現，一些產品對基本生物力學細節的重視，勝過部分大品牌，而較小的業者更願意嘗試新設計。
天津新創品牌Dynafish就是靠產品與口碑突圍的例子。旗下Xiaonian訓練鞋售價約130美元，主打輕量與速度感，並採用通常出現在更昂貴鞋款上的高性能中底泡棉，今年春天在海外跑者社群引發熱議。
熱潮先從Reddit跑鞋討論區開始，買到鞋的跑者分享使用心得，之後出現數十支YouTube評測影片，留言區甚至成為詢問如何從中國網站購鞋的交流場所。
Dynafish共同創辦人Chen Zhu表示，公司成立僅一年半多，只有15名員工，沒有行銷預算。「我們把所有錢都投入產品，沒有花在其他地方。」他坦言，海外市場的反應出乎預期，如今也密切關注跑者回饋。

年輕買家看重產品實力 品牌出海仍須補足通路

法國勃艮第商學院副教授Glyn Atwal認為，歐美年輕消費者對西方品牌的依戀，不像上一代那麼強，尤其許多歐美品牌本來就在海外製造。反應快、能掌握趨勢的中國品牌，愈來愈容易獲得Z世代認同，讓中國產品與創新、科技產生連結。
不過，社群爆紅不代表品牌已站穩市場。以Kofuzi為名經營YouTube頻道的跑鞋評測者Mike Ko，雖欣賞新品牌在沒有龐大行銷資源下崛起，卻尚未評測Dynafish，原因之一就是觀眾不容易買到。
為承接需求，Dynafish正改善官網與線上商店，並擴充產量。Chen Zhu表示，公司首年售出約20萬雙鞋，其中七成在中國；他預估明年銷量可達80萬雙，國內外市場各占一半。
品牌也調整產品名稱。考量英語使用者難以念出小鯰(Xiaonian)，這款鞋在美國改名為Dyna Super。北美經銷商Simon Tse表示，產品可以保留中國品牌的核心，但視覺與語言仍須適應當地市場，才能讓海外消費者更容易接受。
paras_en: From camera lenses and pens to running shoes, some Chinese brands are reshaping European and American consumers' perception of "Made in China." They are no longer just budget alternatives; thanks to quality, design and price advantages they are gaining the approval of discerning equipment users, even prompting overseas buyers to go through the hassle of cross‑border purchases.

The key to this shift is that the products themselves can now stand up to the scrutiny of picky users, and the companies respond quickly to feedback and fill gaps left by big brands, allowing previously unknown players to break into the market through professional reviews and community word‑of‑mouth.

Third‑party lenses are no longer competing on price alone; quality and response speed are earning trust. Camera lenses are among the most technically demanding consumer products, requiring precise alignment of optical elements and flawless autofocus motors and aperture blades. Photographers willing to spend thousands of dollars on a lens are especially exacting about image quality and quality control.

Chinese lens brand Viltrox initially marketed itself as an affordable third‑party option, attracting consumers who did not want to pay more for Japanese‑made lenses. About four years ago the company invested in material and manufacturing improvements and has since launched well‑received products such as a 75 mm portrait lens and a 13 mm wide‑angle lens, shifting the narrative from "good for the price" to genuine product merit.

Chris Lee, who runs the photography YouTube channel pal2tech, says that concerns about third‑party lenses have noticeably faded. When he tested Viltrox products in 2019 he criticized the lenses for being bulky and heavy, but also noted how quickly the company reacted to user feedback.
Lee explained, "I mentioned an issue on the channel and two weeks later a firmware update fixed it."

Viltrox U.S. marketing head Frank Fang pointed out that consumers may like a product as it is, but they also want it smaller, cheaper or better suited to real‑world use; those unmet needs represent opportunities for the brand.

As quality has improved, Viltrox has rolled out lighter, larger‑aperture and different‑focal‑length lenses that fill gaps in the line‑ups of major brands. For photographers who may hold onto a lens for years, those differences can sway a purchase decision. Lee summed it up: "Photographers fall in love with a camera, but they marry the lens."

Similar changes are seen in the fountain‑pen and folding‑knife markets. Chinese pen brands such as Asvine and Hongdian are winning collector approval for their looks and writing performance; former OEMs WE Knife and Reate are gaining user recognition through in‑house designs and meticulous craftsmanship.

Running shoes are another hot area. Anta (02020‑HK) opened a store in Beverly Hills in February, and Li‑Ning (02331‑HK) signed a long‑term endorsement deal with NBA star Stephen Curry in June, expanding their U.S. footprint. Both firms also use running influencers to showcase products and sell on Amazon (AMZN‑US), making them easier for American consumers to buy.

Matt Klein, a physical therapist and founder of the shoe‑review platform Doctors of Running, says some Chinese running shoes are priced far lower yet match or even exceed the quality of established brands. He notes that a few of these shoes pay more attention to basic biomechanical details than some big‑name competitors, and smaller companies are more willing to experiment with new designs.

Tianjin startup Dynafish is a case in point, breaking through on product and word‑of‑mouth. Its Xiaonian training shoe retails for about $130, emphasizes light weight and speed, and uses high‑performance mid‑sole foam normally found in pricier models; it sparked a buzz in overseas running communities in the spring.

The hype started on Reddit’s running‑shoe forums, where buyers posted experiences, followed by dozens of YouTube review videos; the comment sections even became a place to ask how to purchase the shoes from Chinese websites.

Co‑founder Chen Zhu says Dynafish has been operating for just a year and a half with only 15 staff and no marketing budget. "We put all the money into the product and nothing else," he admits, noting that overseas response has exceeded expectations and that they now closely monitor runner feedback.

Young buyers value product performance, but brands still need to fill distribution gaps to go abroad. Glyn Atwal, an associate professor at Burgundy School of Business in France, observes that European and American younger consumers are less attached to Western brands than the previous generation, especially since many of those brands already manufacture overseas. Fast‑reacting Chinese brands that can capture trends are increasingly winning over Gen‑Z, linking Chinese products with innovation and technology.

However, viral social‑media buzz does not guarantee a firm market foothold. Mike Ko, who runs the YouTube channel Kofuzi and reviews running shoes, appreciates new brands rising without massive marketing spend, but he has not yet reviewed Dynafish because his audience finds the shoes hard to purchase.

To meet demand, Dynafish is improving its website and online store while scaling production. Chen Zhu says the company sold about 200,000 pairs in its first year, roughly 70 % of which were in China; he projects next year’s sales could reach 800,000 pairs, split evenly between domestic and overseas markets.

The brand is also tweaking product names. Because English speakers struggle with the name Xiaonian, the shoe is marketed in the U.S. as the Dyna Super. North‑American distributor Simon Tse says the product can retain the core of the Chinese brand, but its visual and linguistic presentation must adapt to local markets to make overseas consumers more comfortable.

items.title: 股價大漲、債券卻跌！SpaceX財報報喜 債市在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Stocks Surge, Bonds Fall! SpaceX Earnings Impress—What Is the Bond Market Afraid Of?
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)財報雖優於預期，激勵股價大漲，但公司積極擴大投資的計畫，也引發市場對債務增加的疑慮。SpaceX債券價格周三(21日)走弱，信用風險指標同步攀升，呈現股市與債市反應分歧的局面。
據《彭博》報導，截至紐約時間周三中午12時35分，SpaceX票面利率6.6%、2046年到期債券的信用利差，擴大9個基點至264個基點，顯示投資人要求更高的風險補償。
這家市值約2兆美元的航太與AI公司周二公布，截至9月底的一季淨利達44億美元，遠高於華爾街預估的18.8億美元；營收年增161%，同樣超出預期，帶動周三股價一度大漲12.44%。
不過，財務長Bret Johnsen在財報電話會議上表示，公司正對預期長期回報最高的三大領域「積極投資」，包括超級智慧部門的算力、Starlink寬頻及行動通訊業務。他也強調，SpaceX計劃維持投資等級信用評等。
即使如此，大舉投資的訊息仍讓債市擔憂，公司可能顯著增加借款。SpaceX今年6月才透過分批發行債券籌得250億美元。《彭博》本月稍早另報導，公司正與銀行及投資人洽談籌資400億美元，用於購買輝達(NVDA-US)晶片。
Bret Johnsen也在電話會議上證實，公司目前正與多個債務資金來源洽談，以支應快速成長所需的資金。
根據ICE Data Services，SpaceX五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價周三一度上升0.8個基點，至約232.6個基點，扭轉稍早下滑走勢。這項指標反映投資人為債務違約風險投保的成本，報價上升通常代表市場疑慮增加。SpaceX的CDS報價在10月大部分時間持續走高，並多次刷新高點。
債務壓力也不只出現在SpaceX。部分大型科技公司的信用風險指標本周升至新高，投資人擔心財報公布後將迎來新一波借款潮，進一步加重債市承接負擔。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，全球企業今年為投入AI而舉借的債務已超過4,500億美元，遠高於去年全年的約2,000億美元，凸顯AI擴張對融資的龐大需求。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) earnings beat expectations, spurring a big stock jump, but the company's aggressive investment expansion plan also raised market concerns about rising debt. SpaceX bond prices weakened on Wednesday (the 21st), and credit risk indicators rose in tandem, showing a divergence between equity and bond market reactions.

According to Bloomberg, as of 12:35 p.m. New York time on Wednesday, the credit spread on SpaceX’s 6.6% bonds maturing in 2046 widened by 9 basis points to 264 basis points, indicating investors are demanding higher risk compensation.

The aerospace and AI firm, valued at about $2 trillion, announced on Tuesday that its Q3 net profit through September ended at $4.4 billion, far above Wall Street’s estimate of $1.88 billion; revenue grew 161% year‑over‑year, also beating forecasts, and drove the stock up as much as 12.44% on Wednesday.

However, CFO Bret Johnsen said in the earnings call that the company is “actively investing” in its three highest‑return long‑term areas, including super‑intelligence computing power, Starlink broadband and mobile communications. He also stressed that SpaceX plans to maintain an investment‑grade credit rating.

Even so, the news of massive investment worries the bond market that the company may significantly increase borrowing. SpaceX only raised $25 billion in June through a staged bond issuance. Bloomberg earlier this month reported that the company is negotiating with banks and investors to raise $40 billion to purchase Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips.
Bret Johnsen also confirmed on the call that the company is currently in talks with multiple sources of debt financing to fund its rapid growth.

Based on ICE Data Services, SpaceX’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) price rose by 0.8 basis points on Wednesday to about 232.6 basis points, reversing an earlier decline. The CDS reflects the cost investors pay to hedge default risk; a higher price usually signals growing market concern. SpaceX’s CDS has been trending higher for most of October, hitting new highs repeatedly.

Debt pressure is not limited to SpaceX. Credit risk indicators for some large tech companies hit new highs this week, as investors fear a fresh wave of borrowing after earnings releases, further burdening the bond market.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that global corporate debt raised this year to fund AI has exceeded $450 billion, far above last year’s roughly $200 billion, highlighting the massive financing demand driven by AI expansion.

items.title: SpaceX財報點火！比特幣價格跟漲 市場盯緊8.7萬美元
items.title_en: SpaceX Earnings Ignite! Bitcoin Price Rises, Market Eyes $87,000
paras: 科技股反彈帶動市場風險偏好回升，買氣也延伸至加密貨幣。比特幣周三(21日)一度上漲2.4%，至84,737美元，擺脫先前交投沉悶的走勢。不過，市場人士對這波漲勢能否延續仍有分歧，部分認為目前主要是部位調整與空頭回補，尚不足以確認新一輪多頭行情啟動。
據《彭博》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)財報激勵科技股走高，重新點燃投資人對高風險資產的興趣，儘管市場對人工智慧(AI)熱潮能否持續仍存疑慮。美國貨幣監理署(OCC)公布針對支付型穩定幣發行商的最終措施，也被視為有利產業發展的訊號，進一步提振情緒。
Coinglass彙整的數據顯示，經過數周去槓桿後，比特幣永續期貨未平倉合約量再度增加，反映部分交易者重新建立槓桿部位，成為近期上漲的動力之一。
Wintermute場外交易員Jasper De Maere表示，亮眼財報與AI投資熱度回升，普遍提振風險資產，但油價仍處於高檔且波動劇烈。他認為，目前比較像跌後回升，尚非新一波漲勢的起點；不過，若比特幣能以足夠動能逼近87,000美元，情況可能迅速改變。
選擇權市場也呈現偏多布局。加密貨幣交易所Deribit表示，買權需求集中在履約價90,000、95,000與100,000美元的合約，顯示部分交易者正布局價格進一步上漲的可能性。
但Arch Lending共同創辦人Himanshu Sahay指出，先前下跌已清除部分多頭部位，這次反彈有很大一部分來自空頭平倉，主要反映部位重新調整，而非新增槓桿大舉進場。
為判斷漲勢是否穩健，以及散戶參與程度，分析師也密切觀察比特幣現貨ETF資金流向。《彭博》彙整數據顯示，過去一個月約有23億美元流入相關基金，其中多數流向貝萊德(BLK-US)旗下的比特幣現貨ETF IBIT(IBIT-US)，顯示投資人興趣回溫。
然而，Glassnode研究人員提醒，ETF雖吸引資金流入，成交量卻未同步放大。他們在周三報告中指出，若資金持續流入，且伴隨成交量增加，才能更有力地證明需求正在擴大，而非僅是單日買盤。
ZeroStack執行長Daniel Reis-Faria則維持樂觀看法，認為比特幣仍有充足動能，推動價格再度走高。
paras_en: Technology stocks rebounded, lifting market risk appetite and extending buying interest to cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin rose 2.4% on Wednesday (the 21st) to $84,737, shaking off its previously sluggish trading. However, market participants remain divided on whether the rally can continue; some view the move as mainly position adjustments and short covering, insufficient to confirm the start of a new bullish phase.

According to Bloomberg, SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) earnings lifted tech stocks and rekindled investor interest in high‑risk assets, even as doubts linger about the sustainability of the AI hype. The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rules for issuers of payment‑type stablecoins were also seen as a positive signal for the industry, further boosting sentiment.

Data compiled by Coinglass shows that after weeks of deleveraging, open interest in Bitcoin perpetual futures has risen again, indicating that some traders are rebuilding leveraged positions, which is one of the drivers behind the recent price gain.

Wintermute OTC trader Jasper De Maere said the strong earnings and renewed AI investment enthusiasm generally lift risk assets, but oil prices remain high and volatile. He believes the market is more of a post‑dip recovery rather than the start of a new rally; however, if Bitcoin can gather enough momentum to approach $87,000, the situation could change quickly.

The options market also shows a bullish tilt. Crypto exchange Deribit reported that call demand is concentrated at strike prices of $90,000, $95,000 and $100,000, suggesting that some traders are positioning for further price upside.

But Arch Lending co‑founder Himanshu Sahay noted that the prior decline cleared out some long positions, and this bounce is largely driven by short covering and position rebalancing rather than a fresh influx of leveraged buying.

To gauge the robustness of the rally and retail participation, analysts are closely watching flows into Bitcoin spot ETFs. Bloomberg’s data show about $2.3 billion entered related funds over the past month, most of it into BlackRock’s (BLK‑US) Bitcoin spot ETF IBIT (IBIT‑US), indicating renewed investor interest.

Nevertheless, Glassnode researchers warned that while ETFs are attracting capital, trading volume has not risen in step. In a Wednesday report they said that sustained inflows accompanied by higher volume are needed to convincingly demonstrate expanding demand rather than a one‑day buying spree.
ZeroStack CEO Daniel Reis‑Faria remains optimistic, believing Bitcoin still has ample momentum to push the price higher again.

items.title: 想排隊搶蘋果摺疊機？iPhone Duo周五開賣 台灣僅供預購取貨
items.title_en: Want to Queue for Apple’s Folding Phone? iPhone Duo Launches Friday, Taiwan Only Allows Pre‑order Pickup
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(21日)表示，旗下首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo將於周五(23日)開賣，部分市場的Apple Store將提供少量現貨，供未預約顧客購買。不過，台灣等市場僅供已在線上下單的顧客取貨，不提供現場購機。
據《路透》報導，iPhone Duo首批線上預購在數分鐘內售罄，部分訂單的交貨時間已延至明年1月。蘋果表示，正努力讓這款新產品盡快交到顧客手中，但上市當天供現場購買的數量有限，安排也因市場而異。
美國、澳洲、加拿大、墨西哥，以及英國與歐洲多數地區，將同時提供線上訂單取貨及少量現場購機服務。
台灣、中國大陸、法國、香港、印度、日本、馬來西亞、南韓、泰國與阿拉伯聯合大公國，則僅供已在線上購買iPhone Duo的顧客取貨。澳門採取不同安排，僅提供現場購買，同樣限量供應。
蘋果在9月發表iPhone Duo，正式進軍三星電子與華為已布局多年的高階摺疊手機市場。分析師預期，蘋果有望迅速在這個利基市場取得主導地位，但初期供貨能力仍面臨考驗。
相較於傳統直板式iPhone，iPhone Duo的結構更複雜。分析師認為，其精密貼合的鉸鏈設計增加製造難度，蘋果可能需要一段時間，才能掌握大規模量產所需的製造流程。
蘋果在聲明中表示，門市團隊期待周五上午迎接顧客，親自體驗iPhone Duo與完整iPhone產品陣容。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL‑US) said on Wednesday (the 21st) that its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, will go on sale on Friday (the 23rd). Some Apple Stores in select markets will have a small amount of stock for walk‑in customers, but in markets such as Taiwan the device will be available only for customers who have placed an online order, with no on‑site sales.

According to Reuters, the initial online pre‑orders for the iPhone Duo sold out within minutes, and delivery dates for some orders have been pushed back to January next year. Apple said it is working to get the new product into customers’ hands as quickly as possible, but on‑site purchase quantities on launch day will be limited and will vary by market.
The United States, Australia, Canada, Mexico, as well as the United Kingdom and most of Europe, will offer both online order pickup and a limited amount of in‑store sales.

Taiwan, mainland China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea, Thailand and the United Arab Emirates will allow only customers who bought the iPhone Duo online to pick it up. Macau has a different arrangement, offering only in‑store purchases, also on a limited basis.

Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo in September, formally entering the high‑end folding‑phone market that Samsung and Huawei have been targeting for years. Analysts expect Apple could quickly gain a leading position in this niche, but its initial supply capability remains a challenge.

Compared with traditional slab‑style iPhones, the iPhone Duo has a more complex structure. Analysts say its precision‑engineered hinge adds manufacturing difficulty, and Apple may need time to master the production processes required for large‑scale volume manufacturing.
In its statement, Apple said store teams are looking forward to welcoming customers on Friday morning to experience the iPhone Duo and the full iPhone product lineup in person.

items.title: 台積電產能太搶手！英特爾擴廠向前 能接住AI商機？
items.title_en: TSMC Capacity Is So Hot! Intel Pushes Forward with Plant Expansion to Capture AI Opportunities?
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)美國晶圓廠擴建取得新進展，亞利桑那州Fab 62已開始安裝生產設備，俄亥俄州新廠也完成首座大型屋頂桁架安裝。在AI帶動晶片需求攀升之際，這些進展顯示，英特爾延宕多年的擴產計畫正逐步推進，但能否吸引足夠外部代工客戶，仍是投資回收的關鍵。

亞利桑那新廠裝機 俄亥俄廠進度仍落後

英特爾晶圓代工主管Naga Chandrasekaran周三(21日)表示，鄰近鳳凰城的Fab 62正進行設備安裝，預計2028年投入營運。鄰近的Fab 52已運作，並於2025年底量產最先進的18A製程晶片，目前主要用於英特爾自家處理器。
設備安裝是晶圓廠投產前的重要階段，也是成本最高的環節，單台設備價格可能達數億美元。相較之下，俄亥俄州新奧爾巴尼廠仍處於結構施工階段，首座大型桁架安裝完成，代表工程進入下一階段。
俄亥俄廠2022年宣布時，原定2025年開始交付晶片，如今首座廠房目標改為2030年完工，第二座預計2031年完成，較原始規劃至少落後五年。
9月曾傳出SK海力士(SKHY-US)可能租用俄亥俄廠部分空間生產記憶體，但雙方均未證實，尚不能視為已取得訂單。

AI需求帶來轉機 外部代工訂單仍待突破

英特爾執行長陳立武2025年3月上任後，對前任執行長季辛格推動的大規模擴產轉趨審慎，強調確認有足夠需求才推進新廠。如今擴建向前邁進，反映公司對未來產能需求的信心有所提升。
目前較明確的動能來自自家產品。用於AI服務的資料中心處理器訂單激增，英特爾正努力追趕需求。公司7月已將今年廠房與設備支出預算提高至約200億美元，並預期2027年將顯著增加，但仍低於華爾街估計台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)約600億美元的支出。
外部代工業務則仍待突破。英特爾尚未替亞利桑那州18A製程爭取到大型外部客戶，過去7奈米與10奈米製程延誤，也讓客戶對再次承諾下單保持謹慎。
不過，台積電先進產能吃緊，可能為英特爾創造機會。瑞穗證券分析師Jordan Klein指出，輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)與博通(AVGO-US)等大廠，爭取台積電產能的競爭非常激烈。
TechInsights分析師Dan Hutcheson認為，客戶希望建立第二供應來源，增加與台積電議價的籌碼。他表示，多家大廠已在英特爾進行測試，但測試能否轉化為量產訂單，仍待觀察。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) has made new progress on its U.S. wafer fab expansions: Arizona's Fab 62 has begun installing production equipment, and the new Ohio plant has completed its first large roof truss installation. As AI drives a surge in chip demand, these steps show Intel's long‑delayed capacity‑building plans are finally moving forward, though attracting enough external foundry customers remains critical for recouping the investment.

Intel wafer‑fab chief Naga Chandrasekaran said on Wednesday (the 21st) that Fab 62 near Phoenix is undergoing equipment installation and is slated to start operations in 2028. The nearby Fab 52 is already running and is expected to begin volume production of its most advanced 18A process chips by the end of 2025, primarily for Intel’s own processors.

Equipment installation is a key pre‑production phase for a fab and also the most costly, with a single machine potentially costing hundreds of millions of dollars. By contrast, the new Albany plant in Ohio is still in the structural construction stage, having just completed its first large truss, indicating the project is moving to the next phase.

When the Ohio plant was announced in 2022, it was originally scheduled to start shipping chips in 2025. Now the first building’s target completion has shifted to 2030, with a second building slated for 2031, pushing the timeline back by at least five years from the original plan.
In September, reports surfaced that SK Hynix (SKHY-US) might lease part of the Ohio facility to produce memory, but neither side confirmed the rumor, so no firm order can be assumed yet.

Since Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger took over in March 2025, he has been more cautious than his predecessor, Pat Sprague, about the massive expansion, emphasizing that new fabs will only proceed once sufficient demand is verified. The current forward movement reflects growing confidence in future capacity needs.

The most concrete driver right now comes from Intel’s own products. Orders for data‑center processors used in AI services have surged, and Intel is scrambling to keep up. In July the company raised its plant‑and‑equipment budget for the year to roughly $20 billion and expects a significant increase by 2027, still well below Wall Street’s estimate of about $60 billion for TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US).

External foundry business, however, remains unproven. Intel has yet to secure a major outside customer for its Arizona 18A process, and past delays with its 7nm and 10nm nodes have made customers hesitant to place new orders.

Nevertheless, TSMC’s advanced capacity is tightening, which could create an opening for Intel. Mizuho analyst Jordan Klein noted that major players such as Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) are fiercely competing for TSMC’s limited capacity.

TechInsights analyst Dan Hutcheson said customers are looking to build a second supply source to strengthen their bargaining position with TSMC. He added that several large companies are already testing Intel’s processes, but whether those tests will translate into volume production orders remains to be seen.

items.title: 蘋果與可口可樂助攻！波克夏股價逼近歷史新高 《巴隆》譽為「終極反AI標的」
items.title_en: Apple and Coca‑Cola Boost Berkshire; Stock Near Historic High, Barron's Calls It “Ultimate Anti‑AI Play”
paras: 波克夏公司(Berkshire Hathaway)(BRK.B-US)股價周二(20日)觸及52周高點，且正逐步邁向歷史新高，《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)報導，這顯示投資人正把資金從人工智慧(AI)概念股轉向防禦型股票，波克夏也因此受惠。
波克夏資產負債表上的現金及約當現金超過3500億美元，各類業務每年可創造近500億美元的稅後獲利，堪稱市場上防禦性最強的大型權值股之一。
波克夏是一家市值超過1.1兆美元的大型綜合企業，在標普500指數中被歸類為金融類股，雖然近期銀行股欲振乏力，但波克夏同時也是金融類股中的防禦型標的，因而相對受青睞。
波克夏的股票投資組合規模達3,600億美元，主要持股包括蘋果(AAPL-US)與可口可樂(Coca-Cola)(KO-US)，這兩檔股票近期表現亮眼。
波克夏A股周二上漲0.9%，報每股805,757美元，盤中稍早曾觸及80.8萬美元，為52周高點。波克夏B股周二上漲1.1%，報每股537.80美元。
波克夏A股曾在2025年5月2日創下收盤歷史新高809,350美元，正好是波克夏年度股東大會的前一天。「股神」巴菲特(Warren Buffett)後來在股東大會上宣布2025年底卸下執行長職務，令投資人大感意外。
這項消息在當時引發波克夏股價賣壓。現年96歲的巴菲特把執行長一職交棒給阿貝爾(Greg Abel)之後，又擔任董事長一段時間，直到今年9月才又卸下董事長職務，由長子霍華德．巴菲特(Howard Buffett)接任。
波克夏股價今年大部分時間的表現都差強人意，反映投資人紛紛轉向AI相關股票。但在近期資金流向逆轉之後，波克夏開始受惠，股價在過去一個月間上漲5%，2026年迄今漲幅擴大到約7%，儘管仍落後標普500指數約7個百分點。
波克夏過去五年的年化報酬率為13.3%，跑贏標普500指數的12.8%。但把時間拉長為10年之後，則由標普500指數以15.3%打敗波克夏的14%。
《巴隆》預估，波克夏帳面價值在9月30日約增至每股54萬美元，與6月30日的52.2萬美元相比增加約3%。帳面價值上升，主因是波克夏持有的多檔股票價格上漲，其中蘋果這檔最大持股的的帳面價值超過750億美元。營業利益也是推升波克夏帳面價值的另一項因素。
蘋果和波克夏近期股價都創下歷史新高。波克夏持有可口可樂將近40年，目前持股價值約370億美元，與波克夏對Alphabet(GOOGL-US)的持股價值相當。
以《巴隆》對9月30日帳面價值的預測計算，波克夏目前股價相當於帳面價值的1.5倍，與過去幾年大部分時間的股價淨值比(1.4至1.5倍)一致。該公司股價淨值比曾在2025年5月升至約1.8倍。
《巴隆周刊》7月曾指出，波克夏股價處於較低水準時頗具吸引力，當時與波克夏業務類似的鐵路及工業類股正在上漲。
paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B‑US) shares hit a 52‑week high on Tuesday (the 20th) and are edging toward an all‑time peak, Barron’s reported, indicating that investors are shifting money from AI‑themed stocks to defensive equities, benefitting Berkshire.

Berkshire’s balance sheet shows cash and cash equivalents exceeding $350 billion, and its various businesses generate nearly $50 billion of after‑tax profit each year, making it one of the strongest defensive large‑cap stocks in the market.

With a market value of over $1.1 trillion, Berkshire is a massive conglomerate classified as a financial stock in the S&P 500. Although recent bank stocks have been sluggish, Berkshire is also a defensive play within the financial sector, earning relative favor.
Berkshire’s equity portfolio totals about $360 billion, with its biggest holdings being Apple (AAPL‑US) and Coca‑Cola (KO‑US), both of which have performed strongly lately.
Berkshire’s Class A shares rose 0.9% on Tuesday to $805,757 per share, briefly touching $808,000 earlier in the session, a 52‑week high. Class B shares gained 1.1% to $537.80 each.

Class A shares previously set an all‑time closing high of $809,350 on May 2, 2025, the day before Berkshire’s annual shareholders’ meeting. At that meeting, “Oracle of Omaha” Warren Buffett announced he would step down as CEO at the end of 2025, surprising investors.

The announcement sparked selling pressure on Berkshire’s stock. The 96‑year‑old Buffett handed the CEO role to Greg Abel, remained chairman for a period, and then stepped down as chairman in September of this year, passing the role to his son Howard Buffett.

Berkshire’s stock performance for most of this year has been modest, reflecting investors’ pivot to AI‑related equities. After a recent reversal in capital flows, the stock has risen about 5% over the past month and roughly 7% year‑to‑date in 2026, still lagging the S&P 500 by about seven percentage points.
Over the past five years Berkshire has delivered an annualized return of 13.3%, beating the S&P 500’s 12.8%. Over a ten‑year horizon, however, the S&P 500’s 15.3% return outpaced Berkshire’s 14%.

Barron’s estimates Berkshire’s book value will rise to roughly $540,000 per share by September 30, up about 3% from $522,000 on June 30. The increase is driven mainly by gains in Berkshire’s stock holdings, especially Apple, whose book value alone exceeds $75 billion, with operating profit also lifting book value.

Apple and Berkshire have both recently hit historic highs. Berkshire has owned Coca‑Cola for nearly 40 years, with the stake now worth about $37 billion, roughly equal to its holding in Alphabet (GOOGL‑US).

Based on Barron’s September 30 book‑value forecast, Berkshire’s current share price is about 1.5 times book value, consistent with the 1.4‑to‑1.5 multiple it has traded at for most of the past several years. The price‑to‑book ratio peaked around 1.8× in May 2025.
Barron’s noted in July that Berkshire’s stock looks attractive when trading at lower levels, at a time when rail and industrial stocks with similar business models were on the rise.

items.title: 明星策略師Tom Lee堅定買入AI股 底氣來自思科百倍行情
items.title_en: Star Strategist Tom Lee Stays Firm on Buying AI Stocks, Backed by Cisco's Hundred‑Fold Rally
paras: 儘管近期股市出現波動，知名策略師Tom Lee依然無所畏懼，明確表示自己正「逢低布局 AI 概念股」。
身兼 Fundstrat 研究部門主管的Tom Lee於週一(19日)晚間發給客戶的影音報告中指出：「由於韓國股市跌破 7 月低點，加上市場開始討論 AI 債務疑慮，AI 領域顯然已籠罩在恐慌情緒之中。」
部分投資人將韓股視為參與 AI 行情的替代標的，因此，韓股大盤及 SK海力士(KR000660) 等科技權值股下跌，也不時拖累美國半導體與 AI 類股。
Lee 指出，投資人近期面臨「兩個市場、兩種走勢」的局面。根據道瓊市場數據，截至周一收盤，標普 500 等權重指數本月上漲 2.56%，高於市值加權標普 500 指數的 0.51% 漲幅。後者走勢主要由少數大型科技與 AI 企業主導。
標普 500 等權重指數上一次創下歷史新高是在 8 月 13 日，標普 500 指數最近一次創高則是在 10 月 6 日。
Lee 以思科系統(CSCO-US) 1990 年代的股價表現作為借鏡，解讀這波回檔，並闡述看多美股的理由。
他指出，1993 年至 1994 年網際網路起步時，這檔科技指標股的股價約為 0.8 美元；思科身為路由器供應商，立即成為受惠者。
到了 1997 年初，思科經股票分割調整後的股價已飆升至每股 9 美元，但壓力也逐漸累積。當時，聯準會主席葛林斯潘已提出股市「非理性繁榮」的警告。
隨著市場擔憂貨幣政策緊縮、分析師對思科營收成長轉趨謹慎，以及網際網路協定交換器的競爭疑慮升高，思科股價在當年稍晚跌至 5 美元。
Lee回顧道：「然而一年後，思科從該低點大幅反彈至 18 美元。」雖然 1998 年因俄羅斯國債違約以及長期資本管理公司（LTCM）倒閉引發市場動盪，思科股價再次拉回，但最終到了 2000 年，股價一路攀升至 80 美元，相較於最初的 0.8 美元暴增了 100 倍。
「我覺得我們現在有點像處於這個階段。儘管走勢顛簸，我認為這一切都只是修正，所以我正在逢低買進 AI 股。」
Lee 表示，他正關注輝達(NVDA-US)在柏林舉行的 GTC 大會，執行長黃仁勳周三發表主題演講。他認為，這可能成為「修正市場方向、重新調整預期的良好契機」。
「這是每半年舉行一次的大會，我認為可能會有許多正面報導。因此，我仍在逢低買進，尤其是 AI 股。」他說。
Lee 也指出，第三季財報季迄今的獲利成長率達 23.8%，表現「令人印象深刻」。未來兩周財報公布行程密集，科技業尤其受到關注。
他援引高盛數據指出，避險基金整體淨部位已降至 2025 年「解放日」以來未見的低水準，這也是股市目前看來具有買進機會的原因。
上周，部分基金因機械式降低風險的操作而減碼多頭部位、增加空頭部位，也就是加碼押注股價下跌；他認為，這可能是為了「保住今年以來的良好績效」。
不過，Lee 表示，這也意味著，這些基金「未來仍有極大的空間重新進場」。
paras_en: Despite recent market volatility, well‑known strategist Tom Lee remains unafraid and clearly states that he is "buying AI concept stocks on dips."

Tom Lee, head of Fundstrat's research division, said in a video report to clients on Monday night (the 19th) that "because the Korean market fell below its July low and the market has started discussing AI debt concerns, the AI sector is clearly shrouded in panic sentiment."

Some investors view Korean equities as an alternative way to participate in the AI rally, so the Korean market index and tech heavyweight SK Hynix (KR000660) fell, occasionally dragging down U.S. semiconductor and AI stocks.

Lee noted that investors are currently facing a "two‑market, two‑trend" situation. According to Dow Jones market data, as of Monday’s close, the equal‑weight S&P 500 and other weighted indices were up 2.56% this month, outpacing the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500’s 0.51% gain. The latter’s performance is driven mainly by a handful of large‑cap tech and AI companies.
The S&P 500 equal‑weight index last hit a record high on August 13, while the standard S&P 500 index most recently reached a new high on October 6.
Lee used Cisco Systems (CSCO‑US) stock performance from the 1990s as a benchmark to interpret the current pullback and to explain his bullish view on U.S. equities.
He pointed out that when the Internet was taking off in 1993‑94, Cisco’s stock was trading around $0.80; as a router supplier, Cisco immediately benefited.
By early 1997, after a stock split, Cisco’s price had surged to $9 per share, but pressure was building. At that time, Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan warned of a "irrational exuberance" in the market.

As concerns grew about tighter monetary policy, analysts grew cautious on Cisco’s revenue growth, and competition over Internet protocol switches intensified, Cisco’s stock fell to $5 later that year.

Lee recalled, "However, a year later Cisco rebounded sharply from that low to $18." Although the 1998 market turmoil caused by the Russian bond default and the LTCM collapse pulled Cisco’s price back, it eventually climbed to $80 by 2000, a 100‑fold increase from the original $0.80.
"I think we’re in a similar stage now. Even though the trend is bumpy, I view it as a correction, so I’m buying AI stocks on the dips," he said.

Lee said he is watching Nvidia (NVDA‑US) at its GTC conference in Berlin, where CEO Jensen Huang will deliver a keynote on Wednesday. He believes this could be a "good opportunity to correct market direction and reset expectations."
"This conference is held every six months, and I expect many positive reports. So I’m still buying on the dips, especially AI stocks," he added.

Lee also noted that Q3 earnings so far have shown a profit growth rate of 23.8%, which he described as "impressive." The next two weeks will see a dense earnings calendar, with tech companies under particular focus.

He cited Goldman Sachs data showing that hedge funds’ overall net positions have fallen to the lowest level since the so‑called "liberation day" of 2025, which he sees as a buying opportunity for the market now.

Last week, some funds reduced long positions and increased short positions through mechanical risk‑reduction trades, essentially betting on a price decline; he believes this may be to "protect the strong performance achieved so far this year."
However, Lee said this also means those funds have "significant room to re‑enter the market in the future."

items.title: 舊晶片也愈租愈貴！AI算力業者喊需求遠超供給
items.title_en: Even Old Chips Are Getting More Expensive to Rent! AI Compute Providers Say Demand Far Outstrips Supply
paras: AI資料中心大舉舉債擴建，引發投資人對新型雲端業者商業模式的疑慮，但Nebius(NBIS-US)表示，AI算力價格漲勢優於預期，需求仍遠超供給。其他業者也指出，就連較舊款輝達GPU的租金都持續走高，為龐大基建投資能否回本提供正面訊號。
據CNBC報導，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)五年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差升至通常被視為財務困境警訊的水準，債券殖利率也攀升。市場擔憂資料中心擴建過度依賴債務，拖累Nebius與Iren(IREN-US)等同業股價近一個月大幅下跌。

算力價格持續走高 Nebius看好未來需求

Nebius營收長Marc Boroditsky周三(21日)表示，公司並未承擔CoreWeave那樣的債務規模，兩者處境不同。他指出，若公司2027年規劃的算力容量全數上線，預料仍會被搶購一空，2028年也可能出現類似情況。
Nebius是近年崛起的新型雲端業者之一，商業模式是投入數十億美元購買輝達(NVDA-US)GPU、興建資料中心，再出租算力。這類業者能否持續取得足夠租金，是投資回收的重要關鍵。
Boroditsky表示，Nebius周二舉行的算力競標顯示，價格仍在上漲，被問及每百萬瓦算力報價是否持續超出預期時，他給予肯定答覆。這項指標用來衡量業者能從一定規模的算力容量收取多少費用。

舊款GPU租金也漲 SpaceX財報提振信心

獲輝達支持的AI資料中心業者Crusoe同樣看好價格走勢。執行長Chase Lochmiller表示，目前A100的租金高於2020年或2021年，H100也比2023年最初部署時更貴。
他指出，AI模型能力大幅進步，讓使用者能透過算力創造更多價值，帶動龐大需求。這也回應市場的一項核心疑慮：新晶片不斷推出，舊款GPU的經濟價值究竟會多快下滑。
對投入巨資購買GPU的業者而言，舊晶片若能持續以具吸引力的價格出租，有助回收投資並獲利。不過，Crusoe的經驗仍屬個別業者情況，不能直接代表整體市場。
SpaceX(SPCX-US)財報也帶來激勵。其AI業務營收大增至75.6億美元，財務長Bret Johnsen表示，目前每瓦報價略高於30至50美元區間的上緣，凸顯算力出租業者的定價能力。
消息帶動Nebius周三股價上漲，CoreWeave、Iren與Applied Digital(APLD-US)盤前也走高。Boroditsky表示，SpaceX的業績印證市場需求活躍，供給仍遠遠落後。
paras_en: AI data centers are aggressively issuing debt to expand, raising investor concerns about the business models of new cloud providers, but Nebius (NBIS-US) says AI compute pricing is rising faster than expected and demand still far exceeds supply. Other providers note that even rentals for older Nvidia GPUs are continuously climbing, signaling a positive sign for recouping massive infrastructure investments.

According to CNBC, CoreWeave (CRWV-US) five‑year credit default swap spreads have risen to levels typically seen as a warning of financial distress, and bond yields have also climbed. The market worries that data‑center expansion is overly reliant on debt, dragging down the stocks of peers such as Nebius and Iren (IREN-US) with sharp declines over the past month.

Compute pricing keeps climbing, Nebius optimistic about future demand. Nebius CFO Marc Boroditsky said on Wednesday the 21st that the company does not carry the same debt scale as CoreWeave and the two situations differ. He noted that if the compute capacity planned for 2027 is fully brought online, it is expected to be snapped up, and a similar situation could occur in 2028.

Nebius is one of the new‑wave cloud providers that have emerged in recent years. Its model involves spending tens of billions of dollars to buy Nvidia (NVDA-US) GPUs, build data centers, and then lease compute capacity. Whether these providers can continue to secure sufficient rental income is a key factor for investment recovery.

Boroditsky said the compute auction Nebius held on Tuesday showed prices still rising, and when asked if the price per megawatt of compute continues to exceed expectations, he answered affirmatively. This metric measures how much a provider can charge for a given scale of compute capacity.

Even older‑model GPU rentals are rising, SpaceX earnings boost confidence. Crusoe, an AI data‑center provider backed by Nvidia, is also bullish on price trends. CEO Chase Lochmiller said current A100 rental rates are higher than in 2020 or 2021, and H100 rates are higher than when first deployed in 2023.

He noted that AI model capabilities have advanced dramatically, allowing users to create more value with compute, driving massive demand. This addresses a core market concern: with new chips constantly launching, how quickly will the economic value of older GPUs decline?

For providers that have poured huge capital into buying GPUs, being able to keep older chips rentable at attractive prices helps recover investment and generate profit. However, Crusoe’s experience is still a single‑company case and does not directly represent the broader market.

SpaceX (SPCX-US) earnings also provided encouragement. Its AI business revenue surged to $7.56 billion, and CFO Bret Johnsen said current per‑watt pricing is slightly above the upper end of the $30‑$50 range, highlighting the pricing power of compute‑leasing providers.

The news lifted Nebius’s share price on Wednesday, and pre‑market gains were also seen in CoreWeave, Iren and Applied Digital (APLD-US). Boroditsky said SpaceX’s performance confirms active market demand, with supply still far behind.

items.title: 台積電產能太搶手！英特爾擴廠向前 能接住AI商機？
items.title_en: TSMC Capacity Is So Hot! Intel Pushes Forward with Plant Expansion to Capture AI Opportunities?
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US)美國晶圓廠擴建取得新進展，亞利桑那州Fab 62已開始安裝生產設備，俄亥俄州新廠也完成首座大型屋頂桁架安裝。在AI帶動晶片需求攀升之際，這些進展顯示，英特爾延宕多年的擴產計畫正逐步推進，但能否吸引足夠外部代工客戶，仍是投資回收的關鍵。

亞利桑那新廠裝機 俄亥俄廠進度仍落後

英特爾晶圓代工主管Naga Chandrasekaran周三(21日)表示，鄰近鳳凰城的Fab 62正進行設備安裝，預計2028年投入營運。鄰近的Fab 52已運作，並於2025年底量產最先進的18A製程晶片，目前主要用於英特爾自家處理器。
設備安裝是晶圓廠投產前的重要階段，也是成本最高的環節，單台設備價格可能達數億美元。相較之下，俄亥俄州新奧爾巴尼廠仍處於結構施工階段，首座大型桁架安裝完成，代表工程進入下一階段。
俄亥俄廠2022年宣布時，原定2025年開始交付晶片，如今首座廠房目標改為2030年完工，第二座預計2031年完成，較原始規劃至少落後五年。
9月曾傳出SK海力士(SKHY-US)可能租用俄亥俄廠部分空間生產記憶體，但雙方均未證實，尚不能視為已取得訂單。

AI需求帶來轉機 外部代工訂單仍待突破

英特爾執行長陳立武2025年3月上任後，對前任執行長季辛格推動的大規模擴產轉趨審慎，強調確認有足夠需求才推進新廠。如今擴建向前邁進，反映公司對未來產能需求的信心有所提升。
目前較明確的動能來自自家產品。用於AI服務的資料中心處理器訂單激增，英特爾正努力追趕需求。公司7月已將今年廠房與設備支出預算提高至約200億美元，並預期2027年將顯著增加，但仍低於華爾街估計台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)約600億美元的支出。
外部代工業務則仍待突破。英特爾尚未替亞利桑那州18A製程爭取到大型外部客戶，過去7奈米與10奈米製程延誤，也讓客戶對再次承諾下單保持謹慎。
不過，台積電先進產能吃緊，可能為英特爾創造機會。瑞穗證券分析師Jordan Klein指出，輝達(NVDA-US)、超微(AMD-US)、蘋果(AAPL-US)與博通(AVGO-US)等大廠，爭取台積電產能的競爭非常激烈。
TechInsights分析師Dan Hutcheson認為，客戶希望建立第二供應來源，增加與台積電議價的籌碼。他表示，多家大廠已在英特爾進行測試，但測試能否轉化為量產訂單，仍待觀察。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) has made new progress on its U.S. wafer fab expansions: Arizona's Fab 62 has begun installing production equipment, and the new Ohio plant has completed its first large roof truss installation. As AI drives a surge in chip demand, these steps show Intel's long‑delayed capacity‑building plans are finally moving forward, though attracting enough external foundry customers remains critical for recouping the investment.

Intel wafer‑fab chief Naga Chandrasekaran said on Wednesday (the 21st) that Fab 62 near Phoenix is undergoing equipment installation and is slated to start operations in 2028. The nearby Fab 52 is already running and is expected to begin volume production of its most advanced 18A process chips by the end of 2025, primarily for Intel’s own processors.

Equipment installation is a key pre‑production phase for a fab and also the most costly, with a single machine potentially costing hundreds of millions of dollars. By contrast, the new Albany plant in Ohio is still in the structural construction stage, having just completed its first large truss, indicating the project is moving to the next phase.

When the Ohio plant was announced in 2022, it was originally scheduled to start shipping chips in 2025. Now the first building’s target completion has shifted to 2030, with a second building slated for 2031, pushing the timeline back by at least five years from the original plan.
In September, reports surfaced that SK Hynix (SKHY-US) might lease part of the Ohio facility to produce memory, but neither side confirmed the rumor, so no firm order can be assumed yet.

Since Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger took over in March 2025, he has been more cautious than his predecessor, Pat Sprague, about the massive expansion, emphasizing that new fabs will only proceed once sufficient demand is verified. The current forward movement reflects growing confidence in future capacity needs.

The most concrete driver right now comes from Intel’s own products. Orders for data‑center processors used in AI services have surged, and Intel is scrambling to keep up. In July the company raised its plant‑and‑equipment budget for the year to roughly $20 billion and expects a significant increase by 2027, still well below Wall Street’s estimate of about $60 billion for TSMC (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US).

External foundry business, however, remains unproven. Intel has yet to secure a major outside customer for its Arizona 18A process, and past delays with its 7nm and 10nm nodes have made customers hesitant to place new orders.

Nevertheless, TSMC’s advanced capacity is tightening, which could create an opening for Intel. Mizuho analyst Jordan Klein noted that major players such as Nvidia (NVDA-US), AMD (AMD‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) are fiercely competing for TSMC’s limited capacity.

TechInsights analyst Dan Hutcheson said customers are looking to build a second supply source to strengthen their bargaining position with TSMC. He added that several large companies are already testing Intel’s processes, but whether those tests will translate into volume production orders remains to be seen.

items.title: 外資連4點讚穩懋站回500元大關 10/23法說前先回補
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Buy Four Times, Stabilizing Wu-Mao Back Above NT$500 Ahead of Oct 23 Earnings Call
paras: 砷化鎵PA大廠穩懋(3105-TW)預計本周五(23日)召開第3季線上法說會，屆時除了公告今(2026)年第3季財報外，也預計針對第4季與明(2027)年釋出最新的營運展望。據盤後資料，穩懋今(21)日在外資連4買張挹注下，終場大漲7.79%，收512元，不僅終止日K連7黑，也站回500元關卡。
穩懋近期遭投信大量調節籌碼，昨(20)日單日遭賣超金額高達20.37億元，成為賣超金額最高的個股，今日再調節小賣40張，已連6賣。
穩懋之前在法說上表示，因記憶體持續缺貨影響，已對今年手機旺季銷售帶來不確定性，但公司在全球高階智慧型手機上RF GaAs晶圓代工居於領導地位，並聚焦於中高階Android及iOS市場，也具有產品競爭優勢，因此對高階機種拉貨動能並不悲觀，惟整體終端銷售狀況，仍須視總體經濟表現，而密切觀察市場變化。
在其他產品部分，穩懋目前已成功將砷化鎵、氮化鎵等技術延伸至低軌衛星、太空通訊等相關領域應用，在全球航太射頻元件市場站穩腳步，也持續切入AI高速及巨量光通訊等傳輸領域。法人預期有助於挹注後續穩懋的營運動能。
據歐系外資報告中也指出，隨著SpaceX(SPCX-US)星鏈V3衛星升級，大幅拉升射頻(RF)元件需求，化合物半導體龍頭廠穩懋有望受惠接單利多。
paras_en: GaAs PA major Wu-Mao (3105-TW) plans to hold its Q3 online earnings conference on Friday (the 23rd). In addition to releasing its 2026 Q3 financial results, it will also present the latest operating outlook for Q4 and 2027. After hours data shows that on the 21st, Wu-Mao surged 7.79% to close at NT$512, boosted by four consecutive foreign‑institution purchases, ending a seven‑day streak of red candles and reclaiming the NT$500 level.

Wu-Mao has recently seen heavy adjustments by institutional investors. On the 20th it experienced a net sell‑off of NT$2.037 billion, the highest sell amount among all stocks, and today it trimmed another 40 shares, marking six consecutive days of net selling.

In previous earnings briefings Wu-Mao noted that ongoing memory shortages create uncertainty for this year’s peak mobile‑phone season, but the company remains a leader in RF GaAs wafer foundry for high‑end smartphones worldwide and is focusing on mid‑to‑high‑end Android and iOS markets, giving it a product‑competitive edge. Therefore, it is not pessimistic about demand for premium devices, though overall end‑user sales will depend on broader economic performance and market dynamics.

Beyond smartphones, Wu-Mao has successfully extended its GaAs and GaN technologies to low‑earth‑orbit satellites, space communications and related applications, solidifying its position in the global aerospace RF component market, and is also moving into AI‑high‑speed and massive‑capacity optical communication transmission fields. Analysts expect these moves to fuel future operational momentum for Wu-Mao.

European‑based foreign investor reports also point out that SpaceX’s (SPCX‑US) Starlink V3 satellite upgrade will sharply boost demand for RF components, positioning compound‑semiconductor leader Wu-Mao to benefit from increased order flow.

items.title: 三三會建議政府落實AI究責制度 呼籲正視潛在風險
items.title_en: The 33rd Exchange Association Urges Government to Implement AI Accountability System and Address Potential Risks
paras: 三三交流會理事長林伯豐今(21)日表示，AI發展應有益人類，政府也應正視AI發展的潛在風險，建立可追責機制，並立法依「人工智慧基本法」，將AI安全落實為可檢測、可追責、可補救的制度，建立「可檢測、可追責、可補救」的具體機制，兼顧科技創新與公共安全。
三三企業交流會今(21)日舉行10月例會，邀集Google台灣區前董事總經理簡立峰，以「AI新趨勢與企業AI轉型」為題發表演講。
簡立峰在演講中指出，因AI的自主創新能力，造成產業核心競爭力改變的領域，屬於「AI新經濟」方面，目前部分產業已出現這樣的現象，但某些傳統產業可能要再等10-20年。
林伯豐則表示，台灣在AI產業鏈及整體供應鏈發展方面具備一定優勢，但面對AI技術快速進步之際，隨著廣泛應用於教育、醫療、金融及產業製造等領域，雖有助提升工作效率、改善生活品質，但當AI具備自行操作網站、程式及資料庫的能力時，若缺乏適當的權限限制與監督，也可能衍生資安及責任歸屬問題。
林伯豐呼籲，目前台灣政府在《人工智慧基本法》公布後，下階段應將AI安全落實為具體制度，讓AI治理從「鼓勵創新」進一步走向「創新與安全並重」，未來AI發展應以人為本，不應單純追求技術能力，更要重視個人隱私、資訊透明及公平性，確保重要決策仍有人類監督，才能在科技創新與公共安全之間取得平衡。
對於後續法規修正上，林伯豐呼籲，政府應有具體配套措施，除了除了人工智慧基本法外，待更詳盡法規確定後，三三會也將提出建議，他期待法律專家及AI領域的專業人才提供意見，目前AI發展是正確的道路，但必須受到正面引導，也才能真正對人類社會帶來助益。
paras_en: The chairman of the 33rd Exchange Association, Lin Bo-feng, said on the 21st that AI development should benefit humanity, and the government must also recognize the potential risks of AI, establishing a mechanism for accountability. He called for legislation based on the "Artificial Intelligence Basic Law" to make AI safety a detectable, accountable, and remedial system, creating concrete mechanisms that balance technological innovation with public safety.

The 33rd Business Exchange Association held its October meeting on the 21st, inviting former Google Taiwan regional CEO Jian Li-feng to give a talk titled "AI New Trends and Enterprise AI Transformation."

In his speech, Jian Li-feng noted that AI’s autonomous innovation capability is reshaping core industry competitiveness, constituting a "new AI economy." Some sectors are already showing this shift, while certain traditional industries may need another 10‑20 years to feel the impact.

Lin Bo-feng pointed out that Taiwan has certain advantages in the AI industry chain and overall supply chain, but as AI technology rapidly advances and is widely applied in education, healthcare, finance, and manufacturing, it can boost efficiency and quality of life. However, when AI can independently operate websites, programs, and databases, a lack of proper permission controls and supervision could generate cybersecurity and liability issues.

Lin Bo-feng urged that after the "Artificial Intelligence Basic Law" is announced, the Taiwanese government should move to implement AI safety as a concrete system, shifting AI governance from merely "encouraging innovation" to "balancing innovation and safety." Future AI development should be human‑centric, not just a pursuit of technical capability, and must emphasize personal privacy, information transparency, and fairness, ensuring that critical decisions remain under human oversight to balance technological progress with public safety.

Regarding future regulatory revisions, Lin Bo-feng called for specific supporting measures from the government. In addition to the Artificial Intelligence Basic Law, once more detailed regulations are finalized, the 33rd Association will submit recommendations. He looks forward to input from legal experts and AI professionals, emphasizing that while AI development is on the right track, it must be positively guided to truly benefit society.

items.title: 台越前三季雙邊互訪破113萬人次 觀光會議聚焦永續及智慧觀光合作
items.title_en: Taiwan and Vietnam Reach Over 1.13 Million Bilateral Visits in First Three Quarters; Tourism Forum Focuses on Sustainable and Smart Tourism Cooperation
paras: 第13屆台越觀光合作會議昨（20）日在嘉義長榮文苑酒店舉行，由交通部觀光署長陳玉秀與越南國家旅遊局局長阮重慶共同主持。陳玉秀表示，今年1至9月台越雙向旅客往來已突破113萬人次，超越疫情前2019年同期的82萬人次，顯示雙方觀光交流升溫。未來將持續透過定期會議及產業交流，深化旅遊安全、永續觀光及特色旅遊等合作，拓展雙向旅遊市場。
此次越方代表團由阮重慶率領各組室及地方政府觀光主管等30人來台，與台方代表就觀光推廣政策、產業發展及雙邊合作方向進行交流。
觀光署表示，台越觀光合作會議自2012年雙方簽署「台越觀光合作瞭解備忘錄」、建立定期交流機制以來，今年邁入第13屆。本屆會議聚焦旅遊安全機制、永續旅遊合作與產業價值創造、美食觀光及文化觀光等議題。會中，雙方並就落實緊急通報與消費爭議處理機制、強化業者管理及保險保障等方向達成共識。
觀光署指出，未來將持續深化雙方在永續旅宿認證及淨零轉型方面的經驗交流，推動地方產業與社區合作，開發特色永續遊程；並透過在地飲食結合文化體驗，促進美食展售與旅遊行程對接，同時互邀旅遊業者、KOL及媒體赴雙方市場踩線考察，拓展雙向觀光商機。
為展現台灣多元觀光特色，觀光署並安排越方代表團參訪故宮南院、板陶窯交趾剪黏工藝園區、新港奉天宮、布袋好美船屋與鹽田，以及阿里山鄒族文化村、奮起湖森林步道等地，體驗台灣自然景觀、工藝文化、宗教信仰與在地生活。
paras_en: The 13th Taiwan‑Vietnam Tourism Cooperation Conference was held yesterday (20th) at the Chang Rong Wen Yuan Hotel in Chiayi, co‑hosted by Taiwan’s Ministry of Transportation and Communications Tourism Bureau Director Chen Yu‑hsu and Vietnam National Tourism Administration Director Nguyen Trung‑qing. Chen said that from January to September, bilateral traveler exchanges topped 1.13 million, surpassing the pre‑COVID 2019 figure of 820,000 and indicating a warming of tourism ties. The two sides will continue to deepen cooperation on travel safety, sustainable tourism and niche tourism through regular meetings and industry exchanges, expanding the two‑way market.

The Vietnamese delegation, led by Nguyen Trung‑qing, comprised about 30 officials from various departments and local tourism authorities who came to Taiwan to discuss tourism promotion policies, industry development and bilateral cooperation directions with their Taiwanese counterparts.

The Tourism Bureau noted that since the 2012 signing of the Taiwan‑Vietnam Tourism Cooperation Memorandum of Understanding and the establishment of a regular exchange mechanism, this year marks the 13th conference. The agenda centered on travel safety mechanisms, sustainable tourism cooperation and industry value creation, as well as culinary and cultural tourism. Both sides reached consensus on implementing emergency reporting and consumer dispute resolution mechanisms, strengthening operator management and insurance protection.

The bureau said it will further deepen exchanges on sustainable lodging certification and net‑zero transition, promote local industry‑community collaborations to develop distinctive sustainable itineraries, and combine local cuisine with cultural experiences to boost food exhibitions and link them to travel packages. It will also invite tourism operators, KOLs and media to conduct market scouting trips, expanding two‑way tourism business opportunities.

To showcase Taiwan’s diverse tourism assets, the bureau arranged visits for the Vietnamese delegation to the Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum, the Ban Tao Kiln and Jiao Zhi Paper‑cutting Craft Park, Xinfeng Temple in Xinfeng, the Budai Haomei Boat House and salt fields, as well as Alishan’s Tsou Cultural Village and the Fenqihu Forest Trail, allowing them to experience Taiwan’s natural scenery, craft culture, religious heritage and local life.

items.title: 輝達發表DSX POD AI工廠 鴻海、台達電等6台廠入列合作夥伴
items.title_en: NVIDIA Unveils DSX POD AI Factory; Foxconn, Delta Electronics and Six Other Taiwanese Firms Join as Partners
paras: 輝達(NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)今(21)日宣布推出DSX POD模組化 AI 工廠架構，合作夥伴中包含鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻佰(Ingrasys)、台達電(2308-TW)、和碩(4938-TW)、廣達(2382-TW)旗下雲達科技(QCT)、緯創(3231-TW)、技嘉(2376-TW)等台廠，預計於2027年初開始在全球交付。
輝達創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳表示，AI工廠真正創造價值的時刻，是開始產生Token，而非建築工程完工。透過DSX POD，輝達將工廠製造的精準度與速度導入AI基礎設施建置，將部署時間從數月縮短至數週，讓客戶更快擴充算力，並啟動能夠創造營收的生產環境。
DSX POD參考設計整合Vera Rubin AI系統、網路、電力及液冷等基礎設施，並由合作夥伴在模組化貨櫃內完成整合與驗證後再交付客戶，部署至已備妥電力、冷卻及網路等基礎設施的場址後即可連接使用，將AI工廠部署時間從6個月縮短至最快14天，協助客戶加速算力建置與營運。
輝達指出，DSX POD將運算設備、網路、線纜、機櫃電力系統及液冷系統的整合與安裝工作移至工廠完成，減少傳統現場建置所需的大量前期規劃、工程施工、專業人力及物流作業。透過工廠預先測試與驗證，也可降低零組件延遲交付，以及現場施工可能產生的錯誤與額外成本。
在架構設計方面，輝達DSX POD將Vera Rubin系統與運作所需的基礎設施整合，採用可重複製造、以貨櫃為單位的設計，讓合作夥伴能夠規模化生產及交付。此設計延續輝達DSX基礎設施平台的理念，但採取不同的系統架構，在專用貨櫃內完成設備整合與驗證後，再運送至部署地點。
在全球合作夥伴方面，輝達正與Anduril、Armada、Bull、Crusoe、DayOne、戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)、台達電、Eaton、鴻海集團旗下鴻佰科技(Ingrasys)、技嘉、慧與科技(HPE)、聯想、和碩、廣達旗下雲達科技(QCT)、施耐德電機(Schneider Electric)、Vertiv及緯創等業者合作。
輝達表示，合作夥伴會在出貨前完成機櫃間布線、配線、管路配置及功能驗證，相關作業可與場址準備工程同步進行，進一步縮短新增算力上線所需時間。部署速度也將影響AI工廠的經濟效益，從開始產生第一個Token、投入模型運算及服務正式工作負載的時間越早，營運商就能越快提供服務並創造營收。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) announced today (the 21st) that it is launching the DSX POD modular AI factory architecture, with partners including Foxconn’s (2317-TW) Ingrasys, Delta Electronics (2308-TW), Pegatron (4938-TW), Quanta’s (2382-TW) QCT, Wistron (3231-TW) and Gigabyte (2376-TW) among other Taiwanese companies, and plans to begin global deliveries in early 2027.

NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang said the moment an AI factory truly creates value is when it starts generating tokens, not when the construction is finished. With DSX POD, NVIDIA will bring the precision and speed of factory manufacturing into AI infrastructure deployment, cutting rollout time from months to weeks, enabling customers to scale compute faster and launch revenue‑generating production environments.

The DSX POD reference design integrates the Vera Rubin AI system, networking, power and liquid‑cooling infrastructure, and after partners complete integration and validation inside a modular container, it is delivered to customers. Once placed at a site that already has power, cooling and networking ready, it can be connected and used, reducing AI factory deployment from six months to as fast as 14 days, helping customers accelerate compute build‑out and operations.

NVIDIA noted that DSX POD moves the integration and installation of compute equipment, networking, cabling, rack power systems and liquid‑cooling systems into the factory, cutting the extensive upfront planning, construction, specialized labor and logistics required for traditional on‑site builds. Pre‑factory testing and validation also lower component delivery delays and reduce on‑site errors and extra costs.

In terms of architecture, NVIDIA’s DSX POD combines the Vera Rubin system with the necessary supporting infrastructure in a repeatable, container‑based design, allowing partners to mass‑produce and deliver at scale. This design builds on the DSX infrastructure platform concept but uses a different system architecture, completing equipment integration and validation inside a dedicated container before shipping to the deployment location.

Globally, NVIDIA is partnering with firms such as Anduril, Armada, Bull, Crusoe, DayOne, Dell Technologies, Delta Electronics, Eaton, Foxconn’s Ingrasys, Gigabyte, HPE, Lenovo, Pegatron, Quanta’s QCT, Schneider Electric, Vertiv and Wistron, among others.

NVIDIA said partners will complete rack cabling, wiring, pipe routing and functional verification before shipment, with these activities synchronized with site‑preparation work, further shortening the time needed to bring additional compute online. Faster deployment also improves the economics of AI factories: the sooner the first token is generated, models are run and workloads go live, the quicker operators can offer services and generate revenue.

items.title: 德微旗下亞昕科技10/23登錄興櫃 參考價120元
items.title_en: Dewei's Subsidiary Yaxin Technology to List on Emerging Stock Board on Oct 23 at NT$120 Reference Price
paras: 德微(3675-TW)旗下子公司功率半導體公司亞昕科技(7960-TW)今(21)日舉辦興櫃前法人說明會，預計10月23日以每股120元參考價登錄興櫃。亞昕科技今年上半年合併營收8.4億元，年增19.21%，營業淨利1.57億元，年增22.7%，每股純益(EPS)2.41元；累計前8月合併營收達11.99億元，每股純益3.46元，營運及獲利表現較去年提升。
董事長張恩傑表示，全球供應鏈調整與高階電源需求升級，為功率半導體產業帶來新的發展機會。亞昕科技將以自主晶圓設計與製造能力為核心，加速布局高階應用市場。此次登錄興櫃是公司邁向下一階段成長的重要里程碑，未來將在維持產業鏈協同效益的同時，提升營運自主性與市場能見度，積極拓展外部客戶及國際合作。
亞昕科技總經理黃忠勇指出，亞昕科技具備四吋、五吋及六吋晶圓平台，提供產品開發、晶圓製造與客製化製程服務，應用涵蓋車用電子、工業控制及消費電子三大領域。近年公司積極拓展車用市場，已透過自有品牌與韓國汽車集團合作，並掌握供應鏈重組帶來的轉單機會；相關功率控制與保護元件也獲國際大廠導入，逐步貢獻營收。
展望明年，亞昕科技將持續深化高階產品開發與量產能力，推動六吋晶圓平台升級及製程去瓶頸化，提高製造效率與產能彈性，並開發800V至1200V高耐壓產品，以及5KW至8KW TVS保護元件，藉由製程精進、產品組合優化與客戶量產導入，提高高附加價值產品的承接能力。
亞昕科技也看好AI應用逐步延伸至自動駕駛、機器人及無人機等Edge AI實體終端，帶動功率元件應用規模與單機價值提升。公司近年已通過德國車用及國際軍規稽核，未來將持續強化製程與品質管理能力，以因應Edge AI設備對電源效率、穩定性及可靠度的要求，爭取新興應用市場商機。
亞昕科技成立於2005年，深耕功率半導體晶圓設計與製造，產品涵蓋整流、功率控制及保護元件。2024年，公司透過受讓達爾科技(Diodes Inc.)基隆廠晶圓業務，以及取得品牌銷售商喜可士公司，進一步強化六吋晶圓平台與自有品牌銷售能力。
股東結構方面，亞昕科技為德微持股76.63%的子公司，美國上市公司達爾科技與德微則有長達15年的股東合作關係。透過集團資源與專業分工，亞昕科技串聯晶圓設計製造、封裝測試及產品銷售，建構垂直整合體系，提升技術協作、產能調度及客戶服務能力。
paras_en: Dewei (3675-TW) subsidiary power semiconductor company Yaxin Technology (7960-TW) held a pre‑listing briefing for the Emerging Stock Board today (Oct 21) and plans to list on Oct 23 with a reference price of NT$120 per share. In the first half of this year, Yaxin reported consolidated revenue of NT$8.4 billion, up 19.21% year‑on‑year, operating profit of NT$1.57 billion, up 22.7%, and earnings per share (EPS) of NT$2.41; for the cumulative January‑August period, consolidated revenue reached NT$11.99 billion and EPS was NT$3.46, showing improved operating and profit performance versus last year.

Chairman Zhang En‑jie said that global supply‑chain adjustments and the upgrade of high‑end power demand create new development opportunities for the power semiconductor industry. Yaxin will focus on its own wafer design and manufacturing capabilities as the core, accelerating its layout in high‑end application markets. Listing on the Emerging Stock Board is a key milestone toward the next growth stage, and the company will enhance operational autonomy and market visibility while maintaining supply‑chain synergies, actively expanding external customers and international collaborations.

General Manager Huang Zhong‑yong pointed out that Yaxin operates 4‑inch, 5‑inch and 6‑inch wafer platforms, offering product development, wafer fabrication and custom process services for automotive electronics, industrial control and consumer electronics. In recent years the company has actively expanded into the automotive market, partnering with a Korean automotive group through its own brand and capturing order‑shift opportunities from supply‑chain restructuring; related power control and protection components have also been adopted by major international OEMs, gradually contributing to revenue.

Looking ahead to next year, Yaxin will continue to deepen high‑end product development and mass‑production capabilities, upgrade the 6‑inch wafer platform and eliminate process bottlenecks to improve manufacturing efficiency and capacity flexibility. It will develop 800‑V to 1200‑V high‑voltage products and 5‑kW to 8‑kW TVS protection devices, leveraging process refinements, optimized product portfolios and customer volume introductions to boost its ability to handle high‑value‑added products.

Yaxin also sees AI applications gradually extending to autonomous driving, robotics and drones—edge AI endpoints—that will drive larger scale and higher unit value for power components. The company has recently passed German automotive and international military‑spec audits, and will keep strengthening process and quality management to meet edge‑AI equipment demands for power efficiency, stability and reliability, seeking new market opportunities.

Founded in 2005, Yaxin has been dedicated to power semiconductor wafer design and manufacturing, with products covering rectifiers, power control and protection components. In 2024 the company acquired the wafer business of Diodes Inc.’s Keelung plant and secured the brand distributor Xikos, further strengthening its 6‑inch wafer platform and own‑brand sales capability.

Regarding shareholder structure, Yaxin is a subsidiary in which Dewei holds 76.63% of the shares; U.S.-listed Diodes Inc. and Dewei have enjoyed a 15‑year shareholder partnership. Leveraging group resources and specialized divisions, Yaxin links wafer design and fabrication, packaging and testing, and product sales into a vertically integrated system, enhancing technical collaboration, capacity scheduling and customer service.

items.title: 元太攜手富士軟片拓日本電子紙看板市場 55吋產品明年3月量產
items.title_en: E Ink Partners with Fujifilm to Enter Japan's Large‑Format E‑Paper Signage Market, 55‑inch Product to Mass‑Produce in March 2027
paras: 電子紙大廠元太(8069-TW)今(21)日宣布，與日本富士軟片影像系統公司(FUJIFILM Imaging Systems)合作，拓展大尺寸彩色電子紙電子看板市場，初期將聚焦日本鐵路產業，雙方目前正進行產品評估，預計2027年陸續推出相關產品，其中55吋E Ink Marquee預計今年12月推出樣品，明年3月進入量產。
元太指出，日本鐵路產業面臨人力短缺，加上傳統紙張海報在印刷、運輸、張貼及汰換等環節的成本持續增加，電子紙看板可透過數位方式更新內容，協助業者簡化資訊更新流程，減少紙張等材料的使用與浪費，並提供更即時、彈性的資訊傳遞方式。
元太總經理洪集茂表示，隨著公司在大尺寸及彩色電子紙技術持續發展，電子紙取代日本交通產業傳統印刷海報具發展潛力。電子紙兼具紙張的視覺呈現效果與數位內容更新的彈性，可協助企業簡化內容更新流程、降低印刷及材料浪費，並以低耗電量提供即時資訊。
富士軟片影像系統董事豐福貴司(Takashi Toyofuku)表示，富士軟片在影像、印刷、色彩管理及品質控管等領域的專業，與元太的電子紙技術形成互補，雙方將結合技術、既有客戶關係及市場經驗，加速大尺寸電子紙在日本市場的導入，初期以鐵路廣告及資訊看板為主，未來再逐步拓展至其他產業。
在產品時程方面，元太表示，55吋E Ink Marquee預計2026年12月推出樣品，2027年3月量產；B1尺寸E Ink Marquee則預計2027年10月推出樣品，2028年1月量產。
此次合作將結合元太的電子紙技術，以及富士軟片影像系統在日本鐵路產業的客戶基礎、安裝能力與營運經驗，共同提供大尺寸彩色電子紙看板整合服務，涵蓋客戶提案、產品導入、安裝及後續營運等環節。
paras_en: E Ink (8069‑TW) announced today (21st) that it is partnering with Japan's Fujifilm Imaging Systems to expand into the large‑format colour e‑paper signage market, initially focusing on Japan's railway sector. The two companies are currently evaluating the product and expect to roll out related offerings gradually from 2027, with a 55‑inch E Ink Marquee sample slated for December this year and mass production planned for March next year.

E Ink noted that Japan’s railway industry faces a labour shortage, and the cost of traditional paper posters – from printing and transport to mounting and replacement – is continuously rising. E‑paper signage can update content digitally, helping operators simplify information‑update workflows, cut paper and material waste, and deliver more timely and flexible information delivery.

E Ink General Manager Hong Ji‑Mao said that as the company continues to develop large‑format and colour e‑paper technology, there is strong potential for e‑paper to replace traditional printed posters in Japan’s transport sector. E‑paper combines the visual feel of paper with the flexibility of digital content updates, enabling firms to streamline content changes, reduce printing and material waste, and provide real‑time information with low power consumption.

Fujifilm Imaging Systems Director Takashi Toyofuku said Fujifilm’s expertise in imaging, printing, colour management and quality control complements E Ink’s e‑paper technology. The partners will combine technology, existing customer relationships and market experience to accelerate the introduction of large‑format e‑paper in Japan, initially targeting railway advertising and information boards, and later expanding to other industries.

Regarding the product timeline, E Ink said the 55‑inch E Ink Marquee is expected to have a sample available in December 2026 and enter mass production in March 2027; the B1‑size E Ink Marquee is slated for a sample in October 2027 and mass production in January 2028.

The collaboration will merge E Ink’s e‑paper technology with Fujifilm Imaging Systems’ customer base, installation capabilities and operational experience in Japan’s railway sector, jointly offering integrated large‑format colour e‑paper signage services that cover proposal, product deployment, installation and ongoing operation.

items.title: 騏億鑫預計11月中旬掛牌上櫃 明年營收成長上看3成能見度達2030年
items.title_en: Qiyi Xin Plans Mid‑November OTC Listing; Revenue Expected to Grow 70% This Year and 25‑30% Next Year with Visibility to 2030
paras: 半導體廠務工程整合服務商騏億鑫(7848-TW)預計11月中旬掛牌上櫃，董事長洪國庭表示，截至9月底在手訂單約44-45億元、能見度達2030年，預估今年營收成長7成、明年可望再成長25-30%。
騏億鑫深耕半導體及高科技廠房廠務系統工程逾20年，由二次配(Hook Up)裝機工程起家，並向上延伸至主系統工程、材料製造銷售及廠務整合服務，目前已成為兼具設計、施工、材料供應及跨系統整合能力之半導體廠務工程供應商。
洪國庭表示，近年全球半導體產業持續推動先進製程及先進封裝擴產，2奈米製程及CoWoS先進封裝建設需求快速增加，帶動二次配工程與設備裝機需求同步成長，受惠主要客戶未來數年持續擴產，營運動能穩健。
騏億鑫除了持續參與台灣新竹、台中、台南、高雄等前段晶圓廠工程外，亦成功切入嘉義及台南先進封裝廠區，已於美國、日本及新加坡設立據點，並取得美國施工許可及日本建築業許可資格。
洪國庭指出，目前美國團隊已具相當規模，參與美國先進製程廠區建設，服務範圍涵蓋PCW、GAS、PPL及EUV設備內連線統包等高技術門檻工程，近期亦將於德州設立辦事處以加深與當地記憶體大廠及半導體業者合作，就近服務當地客戶進行AI資料中心(AIDC)及半導體廠務工程業務之設計及建置。
在半導體廠建設過程中，主系統負責建構廠房基礎水、電、氣供應設施，而二次配工程則進一步將各項管線精準連結至精密製程設備。
騏億鑫長期深耕製程冷卻水系統(PCW)、高純度氣體系統(GAS)、真空排氣系統(Pumping Line)、訊號傳輸系統(E-Sensor)及CAD設計等專業領域，累積豐富海內外施工實績，並取得客戶多項系統別認證，展現優異的工程技術與跨系統整合能力。
除工程服務外，騏億鑫亦積極投入關鍵材料自主化發展，自行生產特規雙C型鋼及組裝氣體分配盤(GAS DP)，提升對關鍵料件品質與交期之掌控能力，並打造兼具工程與材料雙引擎的營運模式。
paras_en: Semiconductor plant‑facility integration service provider Qiyi Xin (7848‑TW) plans to list on the OTC market in mid‑November. Chairman Hong Guoting said that as of the end of September the company had about NT$4.4‑4.5 billion of orders in hand and visibility out to 2030, forecasting a 70% revenue increase this year and a further 25‑30% growth next year.

Qiyi Xin has been deep‑rooted in semiconductor and high‑tech plant‑facility system engineering for more than 20 years, starting with secondary‑equipment (Hook‑Up) installation and expanding upward to main‑system engineering, material manufacturing and sales, and integrated plant services. It now offers a full suite of design, construction, material supply and cross‑system integration capabilities as a semiconductor plant‑facility engineering supplier.

Hong noted that the global semiconductor industry has been continuously expanding advanced process and advanced packaging capacity. Demand for 2‑nm processes and CoWoS advanced packaging is rising rapidly, driving simultaneous growth in secondary‑equipment installation and equipment integration projects. Benefiting from major customers’ multi‑year expansion plans, the company’s operating momentum remains solid.

In addition to ongoing projects at front‑end wafer fabs in Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung, Qiyi Xin has successfully entered advanced packaging sites in Chiayi and Tainan, and has established locations in the United States, Japan and Singapore, obtaining U.S. construction permits and Japanese building‑contractor qualifications.

Hong pointed out that the U.S. team has already reached a considerable scale, participating in the construction of advanced‑process fabs. Its service scope covers high‑technology projects such as PCW, GAS, PPL and EUV equipment internal cabling turnkey contracts. A new office will soon be opened in Texas to deepen cooperation with local memory giants and semiconductor firms, providing nearby design and build services for AI data‑center (AIDC) and semiconductor plant‑facility projects.

During semiconductor fab construction, the main‑system builds the plant’s basic water, power and gas infrastructure, while secondary‑equipment work precisely connects those utilities to the precision‑process equipment.

Qiyi Xin has long specialized in process cooling water systems (PCW), high‑purity gas systems (GAS), vacuum pumping lines, signal transmission systems (E‑Sensor) and CAD design, accumulating extensive domestic and overseas construction experience and earning multiple system‑specific certifications from customers, demonstrating strong engineering expertise and cross‑system integration ability.

Beyond engineering services, Qiyi Xin is actively developing key material self‑sufficiency, producing custom double‑C‑shaped steel and assembling gas distribution panels (GAS DP) in‑house, enhancing control over critical material quality and delivery schedules, and creating a dual‑engine operating model that leverages both engineering and material capabilities.

items.title: 股價大漲、債券卻跌！SpaceX財報報喜 債市在怕什麼？
items.title_en: Stocks Surge, Bonds Fall! SpaceX Earnings Impress—What Is the Bond Market Afraid Of?
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)財報雖優於預期，激勵股價大漲，但公司積極擴大投資的計畫，也引發市場對債務增加的疑慮。SpaceX債券價格周三(21日)走弱，信用風險指標同步攀升，呈現股市與債市反應分歧的局面。
據《彭博》報導，截至紐約時間周三中午12時35分，SpaceX票面利率6.6%、2046年到期債券的信用利差，擴大9個基點至264個基點，顯示投資人要求更高的風險補償。
這家市值約2兆美元的航太與AI公司周二公布，截至9月底的一季淨利達44億美元，遠高於華爾街預估的18.8億美元；營收年增161%，同樣超出預期，帶動周三股價一度大漲12.44%。
不過，財務長Bret Johnsen在財報電話會議上表示，公司正對預期長期回報最高的三大領域「積極投資」，包括超級智慧部門的算力、Starlink寬頻及行動通訊業務。他也強調，SpaceX計劃維持投資等級信用評等。
即使如此，大舉投資的訊息仍讓債市擔憂，公司可能顯著增加借款。SpaceX今年6月才透過分批發行債券籌得250億美元。《彭博》本月稍早另報導，公司正與銀行及投資人洽談籌資400億美元，用於購買輝達(NVDA-US)晶片。
Bret Johnsen也在電話會議上證實，公司目前正與多個債務資金來源洽談，以支應快速成長所需的資金。
根據ICE Data Services，SpaceX五年期信用違約交換(CDS)報價周三一度上升0.8個基點，至約232.6個基點，扭轉稍早下滑走勢。這項指標反映投資人為債務違約風險投保的成本，報價上升通常代表市場疑慮增加。SpaceX的CDS報價在10月大部分時間持續走高，並多次刷新高點。
債務壓力也不只出現在SpaceX。部分大型科技公司的信用風險指標本周升至新高，投資人擔心財報公布後將迎來新一波借款潮，進一步加重債市承接負擔。
《彭博》彙整數據顯示，全球企業今年為投入AI而舉借的債務已超過4,500億美元，遠高於去年全年的約2,000億美元，凸顯AI擴張對融資的龐大需求。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) earnings beat expectations, spurring a big stock jump, but the company's aggressive investment expansion plan also raised market concerns about rising debt. SpaceX bond prices weakened on Wednesday (the 21st), and credit risk indicators rose in tandem, showing a divergence between equity and bond market reactions.

According to Bloomberg, as of 12:35 p.m. New York time on Wednesday, the credit spread on SpaceX’s 6.6% bonds maturing in 2046 widened by 9 basis points to 264 basis points, indicating investors are demanding higher risk compensation.

The aerospace and AI firm, valued at about $2 trillion, announced on Tuesday that its Q3 net profit through September ended at $4.4 billion, far above Wall Street’s estimate of $1.88 billion; revenue grew 161% year‑over‑year, also beating forecasts, and drove the stock up as much as 12.44% on Wednesday.

However, CFO Bret Johnsen said in the earnings call that the company is “actively investing” in its three highest‑return long‑term areas, including super‑intelligence computing power, Starlink broadband and mobile communications. He also stressed that SpaceX plans to maintain an investment‑grade credit rating.

Even so, the news of massive investment worries the bond market that the company may significantly increase borrowing. SpaceX only raised $25 billion in June through a staged bond issuance. Bloomberg earlier this month reported that the company is negotiating with banks and investors to raise $40 billion to purchase Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips.
Bret Johnsen also confirmed on the call that the company is currently in talks with multiple sources of debt financing to fund its rapid growth.

Based on ICE Data Services, SpaceX’s five‑year credit default swap (CDS) price rose by 0.8 basis points on Wednesday to about 232.6 basis points, reversing an earlier decline. The CDS reflects the cost investors pay to hedge default risk; a higher price usually signals growing market concern. SpaceX’s CDS has been trending higher for most of October, hitting new highs repeatedly.

Debt pressure is not limited to SpaceX. Credit risk indicators for some large tech companies hit new highs this week, as investors fear a fresh wave of borrowing after earnings releases, further burdening the bond market.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that global corporate debt raised this year to fund AI has exceeded $450 billion, far above last year’s roughly $200 billion, highlighting the massive financing demand driven by AI expansion.

items.title: Meta財報前瞻｜去年砸錢掀科技股賣壓，今年AI支出上看2,500億美元，市場扛得住？
items.title_en: Meta Earnings Preview: Last Year's Spending Triggered Tech Stock Sell‑off, This Year's AI Spending Could Reach $250 B, Can the Market Withstand It?
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 市場預估Meta Platforms(META-US)今年資本支出約1,400億美元，2027年平均預估約1,900億美元，最高預估則可能突破2,500億美元。各方預測差距懸殊，顯示市場對Meta將投入多少資金擴大AI布局仍缺乏共識，也讓此次財報的資本支出展望格外受到關注。
不過，增加資本支出未必是利多。去年10月底，Meta公布第三季財報，資本支出增幅超過營收成長，並上調後續投資計畫，股價當天重挫超過10%；隨後三週，標普500科技類股累計下跌超過10%，反映投資人對支出擴張與回收速度的疑慮。
今年的不同之處，在於Meta已有新的AI產品進展。公司9月推出AI代理Muse後，股價曾在兩週內上漲20%，顯示市場對AI應用帶動成長抱持期待，也可能讓祖克柏更有信心加碼投資。但產品受到關注，能否進一步轉化為營收與獲利，仍是此次財報需要回答的問題。Meta將於美東時間21日盤後公布第三季財報，市場也將據此檢視，新增支出是否有更明確的業務成長支撐。
另一方面，今年的籌資環境比去年更具挑戰。去年同期，美國10年期公債殖利率低於4%，如今已升破5%，加上AI相關企業大舉發債，融資成本壓力升高，也使CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、甲骨文Oracle(ORCL-US)等業者的擴建資金與償債能力受到關注。
目前雖未見AI需求放緩跡象，但融資成本提高，已對財務較弱的業者形成壓力。投資人也逐漸從全面追逐AI題材，轉向檢視企業是否有足夠資金支應投資，以及新產品帶來的收入，能否跟上支出增加的速度。

paras_en: On October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The market estimates Meta Platforms (META-US) will spend about $140 billion on capital expenditures this year, with an average forecast of roughly $190 billion for 2027 and a high estimate that could exceed $250 billion. The wide range of predictions shows that investors still lack consensus on how much Meta will invest to expand its AI footprint, making the capital‑expenditure outlook in this earnings report a focal point.

However, higher capital spending is not necessarily a positive sign. At the end of October last year, Meta reported its Q3 results, showing capital‑expenditure growth outpacing revenue growth and an upward revision of future investment plans; the stock plunged more than 10% that day. In the following three weeks, S&P 500 technology stocks fell cumulatively over 10%, reflecting investor concerns about the pace of spending expansion versus its payback.

The difference this year is that Meta already has new AI product progress. After the company launched its AI agent Muse in September, the stock rose about 20% within two weeks, indicating market optimism that AI applications will drive growth and possibly giving CEO Mark Zuckerberg more confidence to increase investment. Yet the product’s reception and its ability to translate into revenue and profit remain questions the earnings report must answer. Meta will release its Q3 results after market close on the 21st Eastern Time, and the market will use that data to assess whether the added spending is backed by clearer business‑growth support.

On the other hand, this year’s fundraising environment is more challenging than last year’s. A year ago, the yield on U.S. 10‑year Treasury bonds was below 4%; it has now risen above 5%. Coupled with a wave of AI‑related companies issuing debt, financing costs have increased, putting pressure on the funding and debt‑servicing capabilities of firms such as CoreWeave (CRWV-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US).

Although there are no signs yet of a slowdown in AI demand, higher financing costs are already pressuring financially weaker firms. Investors are gradually shifting from a blanket chase of AI themes to scrutinizing whether companies have sufficient capital to fund their investments and whether revenue from new products can keep pace with rising expenditures.

items.title: SpaceX合併題材飆漲12%！特斯拉股東買單前，先算股權稀釋這筆帳
items.title_en: SpaceX Merger Talk Sends Shares Up 12% – Tesla Shareholders Weigh Dilution Before Paying Up
paras: 2026年10月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX與特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)啟動合併洽談，激勵兩家公司股價於美東時間21日盤中分別一度上漲12%及4%。市場期待整合資源有助強化AI與機器人布局，但特斯拉股東也關注合併估值、後續籌資可能帶來的股權稀釋，以及執行長馬斯克控制權擴大的影響。
控制權差異是市場關注重點。馬斯克掌握SpaceX約80%表決權，在特斯拉則持有約20%股權，引發部分投資人擔心，合併條件可能較有利於SpaceX，並進一步強化馬斯克的影響力。
對特斯拉而言，合併有望加速拓展電動車以外的業務，但短期獲利挹注仍有限。公司約七成營收來自電動車業務，受到美國政府補助退場影響，銷售持續承壓；即使燃料價格上漲帶動全球電動車需求回溫，仍須面對中國車廠的激烈價格競爭。特斯拉將於21日盤後公布第三季財報，營運表現也將受到檢視。
兩家公司的成長週期也不太一致，SpaceX正在投入大額資金，未來可能仍有額外籌資需求；特斯拉則運用本業現金流與充裕現金推動成長。市場普遍認為，若合併後進一步籌資，特斯拉原有股東可能承受更高的股權稀釋風險，因此交易估值能否獲得股東認同，將是重要關卡。
因為特斯拉每股的投票權相同，馬斯克無法只靠自己約20%的持股決定合併。他在業績說明會上坦言，要取得代表過半數已發行股份的股東支持，門檻相當高。
不過，特斯拉散戶持股比重估計超過25%，其中不少人高度支持馬斯克，若多數散戶支持合併，再取得部分機構投資人同意，交易便有機會過關。

paras_en: On October 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – SpaceX and Tesla (TSLA-US) began merger talks, prompting the two stocks to surge during the U.S. East Coast session on the 21st, rising as much as 12% and 4% respectively. The market hopes the integration will strengthen AI and robotics efforts, but Tesla shareholders are also focused on the merger valuation, potential dilution from future financing, and the impact of CEO Elon Musk’s expanded control.

Control‑ownership differences are a key market focus. Musk holds about 80% of the voting power at SpaceX, while his stake in Tesla is roughly 20%, leading some investors to worry that the merger terms could favor SpaceX and further amplify Musk’s influence.

For Tesla, the merger could accelerate expansion beyond electric vehicles, but short‑term profit contributions remain limited. About 70% of its revenue still comes from EV sales, which are under pressure from the phase‑out of U.S. government subsidies. Even if higher fuel prices revive global EV demand, Tesla must still contend with fierce price competition from Chinese automakers. Tesla will release its Q3 earnings after the market close on the 21st, and its operating performance will be closely scrutinized.

The two companies are also on different growth cycles. SpaceX is pouring large amounts of capital into its projects and may need additional financing, whereas Tesla relies on cash flow from its core business and ample cash reserves to fund growth. The market broadly believes that any post‑merger financing could expose existing Tesla shareholders to greater dilution, making shareholder approval of the deal valuation a critical hurdle.

Because each Tesla share carries equal voting rights, Musk cannot unilaterally push the merger with his roughly 20% stake. He admitted at the earnings call that securing support from shareholders representing more than half of the outstanding shares sets a high threshold.

However, retail investors are estimated to own over 25% of Tesla shares, many of whom are strong Musk supporters. If a majority of retail shareholders back the merger and some institutional investors also agree, the deal could clear the hurdle.
